title: Hostel CRUD + multi-hostel switcher
description: Create/edit/list hostels (name, address, contact phone). Dashboard lets the warden switch between hostels.
acceptanceCriteria: Can create, edit, and list multiple hostels
A hostel switcher is visible and changes the active hostel context

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting - HostelListScreen (doubles as the switcher) replaces the Property tab's placeholder, plus a HostelForm screen pushed on top for add/edit. Active hostel id persisted in DataStore (HostelPreferences), same pattern as LODGY-4's AuthPreferences, since it's UI/session state rather than domain data.

Built data/repository/HostelRepository.kt (wraps HostelDao: getByWardenId, create, update), data/prefs/HostelPreferences.kt (DataStore-backed selected-hostel-id), ui/property/HostelListViewModel.kt + HostelListScreen.kt (list of hostel cards, tap to select as active, defaults to the first hostel when none is explicitly selected yet), ui/property/HostelFormViewModel.kt + HostelFormScreen.kt (shared add/edit form, SavedStateHandle-driven hostelId nav arg decides mode). Wired into LodgyNavHost: Property tab now shows HostelListScreen instead of the placeholder, with a hostel_form?hostelId={id} route pushed on top for add/edit (bottom nav bar hides itself on that route, matching the wireframe). `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. AC1 (create/edit/list) and AC2 (switcher changes active context, persisted) both implemented; not yet exercised on-device - this session's emulator has been extremely slow to cold-boot (Windows host, WHPX acceleration confirmed available but still ~15+ min for one boot), so on-device verification is queued for when it comes up rather than blocking every ticket on it. Tester: please actually run this on-device once possible, not just read the code - multi-step nav flows like this are exactly where a code read misses real bugs.
